message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_verify.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":109,"var":"Data/Size","code":"write (fd, Data, Size)","note":"The attacker-controlled fuzz input is written into the temporary file used for verification."},
 {"step":2,"file":"g10/verify.c","function":"verify_signatures","line":81,"var":"sigfile","code":"fp = iobuf_open(sigfile)","note":"The verifier opens the attacker-controlled file as the signature input stream."},
 {"step":3,"file":"g10/verify.c","function":"verify_signatures","line":100,"var":"fp","code":"rc = proc_signature_packets (ctrl, NULL, fp, sl, sigfile );","note":"Verification dispatches the opened stream into the signature packet processor."},
 {"step":4,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_signature_packets","line":1413,"var":"a","code":"rc = do_proc_packets (c, a)","note":"The packet-processing loop is entered with the attacker-controlled stream."},
 {"step":5,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"do_proc_packets","line":1515,"var":"pkt","code":"while ((rc=parse_packet (&parsectx, pkt)) != -1)","note":"Packets are decoded from the stream one by one."},
 {"step":6,"file":"g10/parse-packet.c","function":"parse_plaintext","line":3236,"var":"pkt->pkt.plaintext","code":"pt = pkt->pkt.plaintext = xmalloc (sizeof *pkt->pkt.plaintext + namelen - 1);","note":"A plaintext packet is allocated from the parsed literal-data record and stored in the packet wrapper."},
 {"step":7,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_plaintext","line":827,"var":"pt","code":"PKT_plaintext *pt = pkt->pkt.plaintext;","note":"proc_plaintext keeps a local alias to the plaintext object extracted from the packet wrapper."},
 {"step":8,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_plaintext","line":949,"var":"pkt","code":"free_packet (pkt, NULL);","note":"The owning packet and its plaintext storage are freed here."},
 {"step":9,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_plaintext","line":956,"var":"pt->namelen","code":"extrahash = xtrymalloc (6 + pt->namelen);","note":"The freed plaintext object is immediately reread to compute the extra-hash buffer size, causing the heap-use-after-free read."}
]
pathlib.Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2) + '\n')
PY` executed with exit code 0.
